ayahs.1: Woe to every slanderer who habitually mocks people—destroying reputations for sport in a world built on viral humiliation—
ayahs.2: who hoards wealth and counts it again and again, as though numbers on a screen could secure the soul;
ayahs.3: thinking his fortune makes him immortal—immune to illness, accident, obsolescence, and death.
ayahs.4: Never! He will surely be thrown into al-Hutamah—the Crusher.
ayahs.5: And what will explain to you what the Crusher is?
ayahs.6: It is the Fire kindled by Allah—
ayahs.7: that rises over hearts—the place where greed, cruelty, and arrogance are finally met on their own terms.
ayahs.8: It will close in on them—
ayahs.9: in pillars extended—no exit, no appeal, no lawyer, no legacy left to negotiate.
